channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: PTO Optimizer - Turn Vacation Days into Maximum Days Off
item.description: Split your PTO across chained breaks so weekends ride free - see calendar days off versus one naive block, plus the Wednesday trick. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Slow Cooker Converter - Oven Time to Low and High Settings
item.description: Convert any oven recipe time to slow cooker hours on low or high - with the liquid, dairy and lid-lid rules that carry the dish. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Home Gym Payback Calculator - Months to Beat the Membership
item.description: Equipment cost over your gym fee gives the payback months, the quit-case net with resale, and the 300-dollar starter kit reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Ice Melt Calculator - Bags of Salt for Your Driveway This Winter
item.description: Driveway area, product type and storm count give pounds per application, bags for the winter and the cost - with the pet-paw and concrete warnings. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Gift Return Deadline Calculator - Last Day to Return Anything
item.description: Purchase date plus the store window gives the exact last return day, days remaining, and the holiday-extension fine print - with a calendar download. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Champagne Calculator - Bottles Needed for Your Party
item.description: Guests and glasses per head give the bottles to chill, the total cost, and the mimosa juice ratio - six honest pours per bottle. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Secret Santa Calculator - Gift Pool, Budget Cap and Group Savings
item.description: Participants and budget cap give the number of gifts, the whole-group spend, and what everyone saves versus buying for all - plus the three draw rules. Free.

item.title: Dehumidifier Size Calculator - Pints Per Day for Your Room
item.description: Room area and dampness level give the pints-per-day rating to shop for, the running watts and the monthly cost - with the 40-50 percent target. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Books Per Year Calculator - What Your Daily Pages Add Up To
item.description: Daily pages, average book length and reading speed give your books-per-year total, days per book, and the minutes-a-day reality check. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Dry January Savings Calculator - What the Break Actually Saves
item.description: Your honest weekly drink count times venue price gives the month, quarter or full-year savings - with the visibility trick that makes it stick. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Gym Membership Value Calculator - Cost Per Visit and Break-Even
item.description: Monthly fee over your honest visit count gives the true cost per visit, the break-even against drop-in pricing, and a plain verdict. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Sourdough Starter Feeding Calculator - Flour, Water and Discard
item.description: Starter weight and feeding ratio give the exact flour and water to add, the jar total, and the discard it creates - maintenance, build-up and fridge ratios. Free.

item.title: Electric Blanket Cost Calculator - Per Night and Season Electricity
item.description: Blanket watts, hours and your rate give the per-night cost, the season total, and the ratio against a space heater - warm bed for pocket change. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Flight vs Drive Calculator - All-In Cost Comparison for Any Trip
item.description: Fuel against ticket, bags and airport ground costs - the mechanical money verdict plus the honest door-to-door time rule for choosing plane or car. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Road Trip Fuel Calculator - Gallons, Cost and Per Person
item.description: Miles, mpg and your gas price give the real fuel bill for the trip, split per passenger - plus the honest note on what fuel-only leaves out. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Wrapping Paper Calculator - Rolls, Square Feet and Cost for Your Gifts
item.description: Gift count, size and your honest wrapping style give the square feet of paper, rolls to buy and the cost - with the waste factor priced in. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Christmas Tree Lights Calculator - How Many Strings Your Tree Takes
item.description: Tree height, coverage style and bulb type give the total light count, strings to buy, watts and the season electricity bill. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Christmas Tree Water Calculator - Quarts Per Day and Refill Schedule
item.description: Trunk diameter and stand size give the daily quarts your tree drinks, the refill interval, and the one dry-day rule that keeps the needles on. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: BOGO Calculator - What Buy-One-Get-One Deals Really Discount
item.description: Two prices plus the deal type give what you actually pay, the effective discount, and how it stacks against a plain 30-percent-off sale. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Extended Warranty Calculator - Expected Value Before You Say Yes
item.description: Product price, plan cost and failure odds become an expected-value verdict at the register - with the credit-card double and the self-insurance drawer. Free, no sign-up.
